dct_title_s: Regional map including part of Hennepin, Anoka & Ramsey Counties, Minnesota and the city of Minneapolis, December 1st, 1925
dct_alternative_sm: Regional map including part of Hennepin, Anoka & Ramsey Counties, Minnesota and the city of Minneapolis, December 1st, 1925
dct_description_sm: Also shows railroads and the Public Land Survey grid.; Library's copy bears hand-markings to depict existing terrain and proposed construction. Some lakes, rivers, and green spaces are hand-colored. Roads and proposed roads are marked in ink. Pencil markings indicate "Binding Edge" of a rectangle, 37 1/2 x 25 1/2 inches, at the bottom right of the map.; "8330 / 2-11."--Inscribed in upper right and lower left corners of map recto and map verso.; "#868"--Inscribed in upper left corner of map verso.; "A-4 / E-76"--Inscribed in lower right corner of map verso
